base_packet: project, task, asset, source, export, and target-import identity
accepted brief, visual direction, target contract, and budgets
tool, exporter, importer, engine/runtime, renderer, platform, and build versions
limitations, unknowns, non-claims, and exact decision requested

contracts.trigger: Form, sculpt, topology, surface craft, or asset-family choices require broader 3D artistic ownership beyond the game-pipeline constraint.
Silhouette, proportion, readability, material language, palette, visual hierarchy, or direction fidelity requires acceptance.
The issue crosses importer, material/shader setup, rig/deformation, optimization, platform, automation, or art-to-engine pipeline ownership.
additional_packet: LOD, collision, socket, material, or deformation evidence

contracts.trigger: The issue requires rendering, shader, precision, compression, tangent, memory, draw, GPU, or platform analysis.
The asset affects modular snap, placement, traversal clearance, cover, sightlines, affordances, or world-family composition.
Collision, attachment, destruction, interaction, aim/visibility, vehicle, weapon, or gameplay-state behavior requires implementation or acceptance.
The candidate requires independent round-trip, regression, platform, interaction, or play-context verification.
Reference, texture, scan, kit, generator, trademark, likeness, license, consent, attribution, or derivative-use state is unknown or disputed.

acceptance_rule: A handoff is complete only when the destination can reproduce the state and understand the unresolved decision without hidden chat reasoning. Sending a file alone is not a complete handoff.
